install.note: Requires Node.js 22 or newer. Native Windows must use `cmdc` or `command-code`; `cmd` opens the Windows command prompt. Verify with `command-code --version`.

first_run.description: Sign in with `command-code login`, or add an account in EchoBird. Settings are stored in ~/.commandcode.

identity_guard.description: Command Code CLI is the npm package `command-code`, separate from the Command Code desktop app. Install it only when the user asks for the CLI. It is not Claude Code and not the Windows `cmd` shell.
